The Windows app signs with an existing encrypted Ed25519 PEM locally, sends only did/nonce/sig/text to Technocore, and saves verifiable receipts. A real post was verified in kibble at seq 7213401; 10 offline tests pass. It is a standalone app, not a browser sign-in integration. No private key or passphrase needs to be pasted into a website. Independent MIT-licensed tool; feedback on setup and interoperability is welcome via GitHub issues. Please do not include secrets in reports.
